title: Pricing anchors and bundling sensitivity for latency-critical SMBs
creator: Priya Raman
description:
Objective: Produce a defensible pricing-anchor and bundling recommendation for Redwood’s hosted and dedicated inference offerings targeted at latency-sensitive SMB customers (chatbots, customer support assistants, and in-product copilots). This ticket coordinates competitive analysis, primary market research, and model-landscape monitoring workstreams.

Scope and deliverables:
- Competitive pricing snapshot (per-token, per-embed, reserved vs burst capacity) across 12 peers: include list of public pricing tiers, common bundles (tokens + throughput), and observed discount triggers.
- Latency-tiered value map: define 3 SMB latency buckets (sub-100ms interactive, 100–300ms acceptable, 300–1000ms batch) and estimate willingness-to-pay for each bucket.
- Bundling sensitivity model: simulate 3 bundle designs (tokens-only, tokens+reserved-burst, SLA+observability add-on) and estimate churn/rate uplift using historical telemetry and proxy customer interviews.
- Field interviews: 6–8 SMB buyers and 4 solutions engineers to collect buying criteria and negotiation anchors.
- Model landscape tracker: live sheet mapping model compatibility (quantization readiness, latency per-1k tokens on p4/p8 equivalence), recommended fallback variants, and licensing constraints for bundling choices.
- Recommendations: 1-page pricing anchor chart, 3 recommended bundles with ramp plan, A/B test plan for pricing, and gating checklist for Dedicated contract template updates.

Research plan and artifacts:
- Competitive scrape + manual verification (deliverable: pricing_snapshot.csv, note links in Confluence).
- Synthetic workload microbenchmarks for 3 representative prompts per SMB bucket; link to perf lab run (https://drive.google.com/perf-lab/smb-bench).
- Interview guides and notes (Confluence: /pricing-research/smb-latency).
- Model compatibility tracker (spreadsheet): columns = model, quantization, p4/p8 median latency, embedding latency, license type, fallback variant.

Success metrics:
- Prepare 3 bundles that statistically increase projected ARR by >= 12% for latency-critical SMB segment in the conservative model, or reduce churn risk by >= 8% when compared with current pricing baseline.
- Deliverables reviewed and approved by Sales Lead and Head of Product with actionable next steps for pricing experiments.

Risks and mitigation:
- Risk: public pricing is noisy and non-comparable across vendors. Mitigation: use normalized per-1k token and per-1000-embed metrics and annotate assumptions.
- Risk: small interview sample may bias WTP estimates. Mitigation: weight interview signals with telemetry-derived usage histograms and run quick in-product pricing choice experiments with opt-in beta customers.

Notes and links:
- Initial competitor list and raw scrape results: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/competitive-pricing-snap
- Perf lab notebooks and raw traces: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/rl-inference-perf/smb-latency
- Draft 1-pager for internal review: https://confluence.redwood/products/pricing-anchors-smb

Next steps (owners):

- Priya: schedule and run buyer interviews, synthesize notes (due 2026-03-24).
